text:
Maria (partnerships): Hey team — Redtail confirmed HW preview next week. NDA is signed, they shipped two QA units (serials in DM). Need to align on benchmarks, telemetry hooks, and a very small gating checklist before we let partners run on shared infra.
Owen (eng-ml): Nice. Can you paste the hw perf spec? I want to pick model suites and token lengths.
Redtail PM: Link: https://redtail.example.com/specs/rt-x1.pdf — FW 1.2.3 on both units. We're ok with you running synthetic suites.
Sophia (eng-runtime): For FW 1.2.3 we need to disable the aggressive mem compaction in one slot — it regresses kv cache. Will add a runtime flag.
Raj (platform): We can reserve a Dedicated slot Tue/Wed 09:00-12:00 PST. Is that enough for baseline + two regressions?
Owen (eng-ml): Should be. Plan: run 1) perf synthetic (throughput/latency), 2) end-to-end LLM chat traces (1K prompts), 3) stability soak (1h).
Maria (partnerships): +1. Also Redtail requested telemetry hooks — they want hw counters and packet-level logs. What's the minimal set we can expose?
Sophia (eng-runtime): Minimal: GPU temp, core freq, PCIe errors, kernel-latency histograms, kv-cache hit/miss. We'll surface via telemetry endpoint (/telemetry/rt-x1).
Redtail PM: Good. We can accept that. We'll also send an NDA addendum to allow raw hw counters for debug.
Owen (eng-ml): Quick benchmark command for reproducibility:
```bash
python bench_runner.py --model gpt-small --seq-len 1024 --batch 8 --tokens 50 --profile /tmp/rtx1-run.json
```
Run that on both units and attach the profile JSON.
Raj (platform): I'll create a dedicated route in staging so logs don't mix with prod. Route: /partner/redtail/rtx1. Also will set quotas.
deploy-bot: CI job scheduled: partnerships/redtail/preview/3712345678 - test-matrix started.
Maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) Owen: choose 3 eval prompts and run the bench command on both units 2) Sophia: add telemetry endpoint + runtime flag 3) Raj: reserve slots & create route 4) Maria: coordinate NDA addendum and announce test window to Redtail. I'll sync with Redtail PM after your updates.
Owen (eng-ml): I'll push prompt set by EOD today.
Sophia (eng-runtime): Started work on flag — will open PR with instructions for the QA team.
Raj (platform): Reserved Tue/Wed 09-12 PST and created the route. Quotas set to 100k tokens/day for the slot.
Redtail PM: Thanks all — we'll aim to have on-site engineer on Tue morning. Please ping me in-channel when profiles are uploaded.
Maria (partnerships): Ping noted. Let's try to keep runs short and include a strict rollback plan if any unit starts overheating. Use the usual emergency stop: `kill -9 bench_runner` then alert oncall.
Owen (eng-ml): Got it. I will tag @oncall if temps > 85C.
Sophia (eng-runtime): PR: github.com/redwood/rt-runtime/pull/817 — includes telemetry endpoint and --disable-mem-compaction flag. Test instructions in the PR body.
Maria (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop for now. We'll reconvene Mon 17:00 PST for a pre-flight check. :calendar:
